## Review: ACCEPT (in-seat) — PR objectui#11727 (head `0ef8b17`) · contract review owed before enqueue

`domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z` · reviewed against the PR diff and check runs, read 2026-10-06T15:36Z. Report: `os-dev-report` on this card.

- **Shape:** draft → `main`; body line 1 `Fixes #11687`; `Clause-②: yes` at line start; PR assignee `huangyiirene` (= card).
- **Scope:** 17 files, all inside the claim's surface:
  - `managedByEmptyState.ts` and its caller `ObjectView.tsx`;
  - `ListView.tsx`;
  - the ten locale packs;
  - three test files;
  - one changeset.

  +596/−27. Nothing under `content/docs/releases/`.
- **Clause-② on the diff:**
  - It grows the published surface by one locale key, `list.viewFilterNoMatchesMessage`, in all ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs, and by one entry in `@object-ui/plugin-list`'s exported `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`.
  - `listToolbarDrawsAction` and the new `pageOffersCreate` parameter live in `packages/app-shell/src/utils/managedByEmptyState.ts`. That module is not re-exported from the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry (`exports` = `.` and `./styles.css`; zero hits in `src/index.ts`), so `app-shell` stays `patch`.
  - Changeset levels: `plugin-list` minor, `i18n` minor, `app-shell` patch. That matches the claim's "at least minor where the surface grows".
- **Mechanism checked on the diff:**
  - The `better-auth` arm returns `undefined` when `pageOffersCreate`, after the `sys_team` arm, which keeps its own copy.
  - `pageOffersCreate` = the New button (`objectCanCreate && createVisible`), or any `list_toolbar` action that passes `actionRendersAt`, the `useCapabilityGate` closure and a fail-closed `visible`.
  - `ListView` splits `hasUserQuery` from `hasBaseFilter`. Title: `noMatches` for either. Message: user query → `noMatchesMessage`; view filter only → `viewFilterNoMatchesMessage`; neither → first-run. objectui#4155's reason holds: a view-filtered empty list never gets first-run copy.
- **Changeset sentences checked against the diff:**
  - "…asks whether the page offers a way to add a row: its New button, or a toolbar action the page draws, judged by the same placement, capability and `visible` gates": matches `listToolbarDrawsAction`.
  - "When the toolbar action is hidden (… single-organization …), the identity copy stays": matches the fail-closed `visible`.
  - "The Teams list keeps its own copy": matches.
  - "…said only when the user applied a filter or a search … reads 'No records match this view’s filter.' … in all ten language packs and in `LIST_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`": matches. "A list with no filter at all still gets the first-run copy": matches.
- **H4 corrected by the dev, accepted:** the API Keys page offers no create action (`sys_api_key` declares no `list_toolbar` action and leaves `create` off), so its pin is the negative case and its identity copy stays.
- **The dev's open question — which predicate means "the page offers a create action": the seat takes A (shipped), no escalation.**
  - It is an implementation predicate behind the card's own `Done when`, not a contract shape.
  - Long term: A reads the toolbar's own verdict, so the copy can never disagree with a drawn button. The cost is a second evaluation of the `visible` gate beside `action:button`, which the code comment names.
  - Business need: A fixes the measured pages with no cross-repo change.
  - Guarding against AI-authored mistakes: B would make the `mode: 'create'` hint drive UI copy, which is new metadata semantics that authors would have to know.
  - Startup focus: B is producer work across eight objectstack actions with zero pull.
- **Tests:** 33 cases across the three touched suites. Three ablations from committed state, each red at its own pins. Full suites: `i18n` 80 files, `plugin-list` 113 files, `app-shell` 1032 files, all green at `0ef8b17`.
- **CI at `0ef8b17`:** 42 runs, still converging (13 `in_progress` at this read); no completed run is red.
- **Out-of-scope findings:**
  - The managed-by `emptyState` outranks the list's query-aware copy, so a search on API Keys reads "No identity records": **dropped as a card** (`reach:` not measured at a public door; source reading only). Acceptance notes.
  - `featureGatePredicate`'s doc says an absent default-on flag fails open, but objectui's evaluator throws and the fail-closed `visible` hides it. It is a seam candidate (`spec:featureGatePredicate` → `renderer:action-button`), measured in-process only, so it is **not filed** (`reach:` not met). It goes to the round report for triage's eyes.
  - The two copy notes (API Keys wording; `sys_team` naming a gated Create Team) and the deep-link behaviour note: Acceptance notes.
- **Owed before enqueue:** an isolated contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` on this head (`Clause-②: yes`). `needs:contract-review` is hung on the PR in the same stroke as this comment.
